metaDescription: Six pressure washers at or under $200, compared on rated versus max PSI and GPM, soap tanks, wheels and how to spot claims no household outlet can deliver.
expertTake: The Westinghouse ePX3500 is the best overall pick because it publishes both its max figures and its rated 2000 PSI at 1.2 GPM, which is the information you need to compare machines. The CRAFTSMAN 1900 is the value pick for a plain, honest unit with a soap tank. Treat any electric washer claiming thousands of PSI from a household plug with suspicion.
introParagraphs: Around this price, electric pressure washers become decent decks-and-fences tools, but the listings also become more misleading. Some quote rated figures; others quote peaks or numbers no wall outlet can power.
The skill is reading which kind of number you are looking at. Prices move, and the $200 cap reflects listing prices when this guide was updated.

products.name: Westinghouse ePX3500 2500 Max PSI Electric Pressure Washer

specList.label: Hose and soap
specList.value: 25 ft braided hose, 20 oz soap tank

products.description:
The ePX3500 does what few listings in this band do: it states a rated 2000 PSI and 1.2 GPM alongside its 2500 max PSI and 1.76 max GPM. The rated pair gives about 2,400 cleaning units, the honest basis for comparing it with other washers. The max numbers occur at different settings and should be read as a ceiling.

At 19 pounds and 16.5 inches tall with four quick-lock wheels, it is easy to move and store, and anti-tipping geometry keeps it upright as you pull the 25 foot braided hose. A 20 ounce onboard soap tank covers car and deck washing without a separate bottle.

Compared with the CRAFTSMAN 1900, you gain higher rated pressure and a wheeled, anti-tipping body. Drain the pump before freezing weather and keep the inlet screen clean. The braided hose resists kinks better than a vinyl one, and a quick-lock wheel set makes the machine easier to roll over uneven ground. Always run the trigger open for a minute to purge air before building pressure, which protects the pump. With a rated pair published, you can estimate how it will behave against a wooden deck: a 25 degree tip at a foot or two away is a safe start, and you can move closer for stained concrete.
products.bestFor: Decks, fences and cars with honest rated numbers.
pros: Rated 2000 PSI at 1.2 GPM stated in the listing
cons: Max PSI and max GPM are not simultaneous

products.name: CRAFTSMAN CMEPW1900 1900 PSI 1.2 GPM Electric Pressure Washer

specList.label: Storage
specList.value: Onboard nozzle, hose, cord and wand storage

products.description:
The CRAFTSMAN states 1900 max PSI and 1.2 GPM, which gives roughly 2,280 cleaning units at the maximum. It has an integrated soap tank and onboard storage for the nozzle, hose, cord and wand, which keeps the pieces together and reduces the chance of losing tips.

Its numbers are close to the Westinghouse's rated pair, and the plain spec sheet is easy to trust. It lacks the anti-tipping design and the braided hose of the ePX3500, but it is simpler.

Drain it for winter and keep the inlet clean. It suits a homeowner who wants an uncomplicated machine from a known name. Because the cord and hose are shorter than a gas machine's, plan your cleaning route so the washer sits centrally. Use a GFCI-protected outlet and keep the plug off wet ground. Its simplicity is the selling point, so do not expect a fancy trigger or an anti-tipping base. Store the tips in the onboard slots, because loose tips are the part everyone loses first.

products.name: Westinghouse ePX3100 2300 Max PSI Anti-Tipping Pressure Washer
products.description:
The ePX3100 sits below the ePX3500 on max pressure and does not publish a rated pair in the listing, so you rely on the brand's other washers for guidance. Its anti-tipping body is the practical benefit.

It is a sensible choice if the price lands below the ePX3500.

Store it drained. If the price is within a few dollars of the ePX3500, buy the ePX3500, since the published rated figures and the soap tank are worth the small difference. Otherwise, it is a perfectly good machine for a smaller job list. Anti-tipping bases rely on a wide stance, so keep the machine on level ground and avoid tugging the hose sharply. If it does tip, shut the machine off before you lift it.
products.bestFor: Decks and cars when the price is right.

products.name: Westinghouse ePX3100v 2100 Max PSI Pressure Washer
products.description:
The ePX3100v is the carry-handle version of the Westinghouse line. It suits someone who stores the washer on a shelf and carries it to the work.

Its lower max pressure than the ePX3500 is a minor difference in practice.

Store it drained. A built-in handle makes carrying painless, but check where the hose and cord wrap so they do not trail. Compared with the CRAFTSMAN, you lose the soap tank and onboard storage. Because the handle is the main feature, it is worth checking the weight in the specifications and seeing if you can lift it comfortably with one hand. A short pull on the hose keeps it from rolling.

products.name: LWQ Portable Pressure Washer 4 Metal Quick-Connect Nozzles
products.description:
The LWQ comes with four metal quick-connect nozzles of different spray angles and a two-roller body for movement. Its listing claims up to 2.5 GPM, a figure that is unusually high for a household electric washer and should be treated as a claim rather than a rating.

Metal tips outlast plastic ones, which wear and crack. The brand is little known, so parts and support are uncertain.

Keep the inlet clean and store it drained. Verify what is in the box before use, test each nozzle and check the quick-connect fittings for leaks. If a listing makes extraordinary claims, read recent owner comments before you commit. With the metal tips, test each one on a hidden patch of the surface before you start, since the 0 degree tip is meant for stubborn spots only. A rolling base helps, but the cord still limits your reach.
products.bestFor: Buyers who want a full set of metal tips.

products.name: KEEPEAK Cordless Pressure Washer 1450 PSI 2 x 4.0Ah
products.description:
The KEEPEAK is a battery handheld that draws from a bucket or hose. It is a rinse tool, not a driveway cleaner.

Its peak pressure is lower than the corded units and its flow is much lower.

Keep the batteries indoors. Because the pump is small, treat it as a rinse tool for hulls, bikes and outdoor furniture, and be realistic about how long a pair of batteries lasts at full output. Expect to charge both batteries before an outdoor project, and rinse the nozzle after use to keep it clear. For real concrete cleaning, a corded machine is a better tool. Plan on rinsing soap off before it dries, since dried soap leaves streaks on dark siding and decks.
products.bestFor: Boats, bikes and cars away from an outlet.

buyingCriteria.explanation: The ePX3500 lists 2500 max PSI and 1.76 max GPM and also a rated 2000 PSI at 1.2 GPM. The rated pair, about 2,400 cleaning units, is the number to compare. A listing with only max numbers tells you far less. Check the length of the cord and hose to match the distance from outlet to work area.

A household 15-amp circuit delivers on the order of 1,800 watts. A listing in this band claiming 4500 PSI at 2.8 GPM from a plug is physically implausible. Be wary of any figure far above the stated rated numbers of the established brands. Prefer a unit with a GFCI plug, which cuts power if water reaches the cord.

PSI times GPM gives a fast comparison. The CRAFTSMAN's 1900 at 1.2 GPM is about 2,280 at its maximum, and the ePX3500's rated pair about 2,400. Flow often sets cleaning speed more than the pressure headline. If you will use detergent often, choose an onboard tank or a foam cannon.

The ePX3500 weighs 19 pounds with anti-tipping geometry and quick-lock wheels. The CRAFTSMAN has onboard storage for tips and wand. Small details make a washer pleasant to use. Check that replacement hoses and wands are sold for the model.

The LWQ includes four metal quick-connect nozzles. Plastic tips crack and wear, and metal ones last. Check the tip set and the quick-connect fittings. Verify the inlet fitting matches a standard garden hose. Rinse metal tips after use and wipe the O-rings with a drop of silicone grease, which helps them seal and last longer.

High-pressure water can penetrate skin. Never point it at people or pets, wear eye protection and avoid running the pump dry. Think about weight, since you will carry the unit up steps. Finally, compare the warranty period, because a pump failure in year two is the commonest complaint with electrics. Keep a roll of thread tape in the toolbox for the hose and wand connections.

howWeEvaluated.title: Specification honesty
howWeEvaluated.description: We graded listings that state rated PSI and GPM above those with peaks only. The ePX3500 led. Published rated figures were worth more than the largest headline.

howWeEvaluated.title: Plausibility
howWeEvaluated.description: We checked claimed flow and pressure against what a household outlet can power and discounted outliers. A claim that exceeds what a household circuit can supply was discounted heavily.

howWeEvaluated.title: Handling
howWeEvaluated.description: We looked at weight, wheels, anti-tipping design and storage. Wheels, weight and anti-tipping geometry affect daily use more than the spec sheet suggests.

howWeEvaluated.title: Accessories
howWeEvaluated.description: We counted soap tanks, tips and hoses. Metal tips and onboard storage counted toward accessories.

howWeEvaluated.title: Ownership
howWeEvaluated.description: We considered winter storage, parts and brand. Owner feedback patterns informed the durability view. We kept safety guidance conservative because water at this pressure can injure. Take the order as a starting point, then adjust it to your own list of chores.

howToChoose.subheading: For Deck and Fence Cleaning Specifically

cards.label: Look for
cards.text: Moderate pressure, a wide tip and enough flow to rinse. Keep the tip moving to avoid gouging wood.

cards.label: In this comparison
cards.text: The ePX3500 with its rated pair is the best fit, and the CRAFTSMAN the simple alternative.

cards.label: Spend more if
cards.text: You have a large driveway or want faster work. Higher-flow or gas washers sit above this cap.

cards.text: You wash cars and furniture. The CRAFTSMAN or ePX3100v covers it.

maintenance.why: Debris blocks flow and strains the pump. Run clean water through the pump after using soap, then drain it fully.
Frozen water can crack the pump. Coil the hose loosely and keep fittings out of dirt.
Leaks reduce pressure and soak the cord. Replace a worn wand or hose before it fails under pressure.

faq.q: Why does the ePX3500 list two sets of numbers?
faq.a: Max PSI and GPM are the pump's peaks, while rated PSI and GPM describe normal operation. The rated pair is the one to compare. The rated pair is the more honest guide to cleaning speed.

faq.q: Can an electric washer really deliver 4500 PSI?
faq.a: Not from a household outlet. A listing claiming that is almost certainly mislabeled. Trust rated figures from established brands. If a claim sounds too big, it probably is.
PSI times GPM. It is a quick way to compare cleaning speed across machines. Use it to compare machines in the same class.

faq.q: Can I use a pressure washer on wood?
faq.a: Yes with a wide tip and moderate pressure, keeping it moving. A 0 degree tip will gouge wood. Start far from the surface and move closer. Rinse soap from the surface before it dries to avoid streaking.

faq.q: How do I store a washer in winter?
faq.a: Drain water from the pump and hose and store it indoors. Storing it dry prevents most winter damage.
